biggest_catch: This is not income — it is a partial refund on a thermostat you must buy first ($100-$250 out of pocket). Amounts are entirely utility-specific: typical 2026 rebates are $50-$125 (PSE $75, Naperville $75, Cleco up to $100, Norwich PUC up to $125); the catalog's '$25-$200+' is a national range, not a promise, and some utilities offer nothing at all. Buying a non-qualifying model, buying outside the program's purchase window, or missing the filing deadline gets you $0.
catches: You must buy the thermostat first and pay full price — the rebate only offsets part of the cost, and on every 2026 program found the rebate cannot exceed what you paid (PSE, SWEPCO, Cleco).
The model must be on the utility's qualifying list — typically a Wi-Fi smart thermostat, often ENERGY STAR certified; a generic programmable thermostat does not qualify.

Purchase-window rules are strict: PSE requires purchase, installation, and connection between now and 12/31/2026; Norwich PUC FY27 covers purchases July 1, 2026 – June 30, 2027; applications must be filed within the window (PSE: 60 days of purchase; Naperville: within 120 days of installation; SWEPCO: 30 days of install).
Per-account caps apply (Norwich PUC: 2 rebates; Naperville: 2 per household; Cleco: first unit $75, second $25).
Payout form varies: most pay as a utility-bill credit, but SWEPCO issues a prepaid Visa gift card that must be activated within 7 months and spent within 4 months of activation.
Rebates are funded and can be withdrawn when funding is exhausted (Naperville: 'offered until all funding is allocated').
Demand-response enrollment bonuses (e.g., Rush Hour Rewards bill credits) are separate programs from purchase rebates — do not stack them in your math unless your utility offers both.

c1.evidence: Puget Sound Energy (PSE), City of Naperville Electric Utility, Norwich Public Utilities, SWEPCO, Cleco — all real operating utilities with live 2026 rebate pages; ENERGY STAR rebate finder on energystar.gov is EPA's live partner-rebate directory.

c2.evidence: PSE 'Smart Thermostat Rebate' page: purchase/install/connect a qualifying smart thermostat 'between now and 12/31/2026' with 60-day filing window; Norwich PUC FY27 rebate form (crawled 78 days ago): 'Get up to $125 back... for purchases made between July 1, 2026 – June 30, 2027'; Naperville: '$75 rebate... within 120 days of installation date.'

c3.evidence: No enrollment or participation fee on any program page; the required purchase is the qualifying purchase itself, not a fee. Utility bill credit or gift card issued at no cost.

c4.evidence: PSE: '$75 rebate' (plus '$130 Efficiency Boost rebate based on your income' for income-qualified customers); Naperville: 'customers will receive a one-time $75 credit on their utility bill within two months'; Norwich PUC: 'up to $125 back' with requests received by July 15, 2027.

eligibility: Residential electric/gas customer of a participating utility. Must purchase and install a qualifying Wi-Fi-enabled smart thermostat (usually on the utility's qualified list / ENERGY STAR certified) within the program's purchase window and submit the application with receipt inside the filing deadline.

steps: Go to the ENERGY STAR rebate finder at https://www.energystar.gov/rebate-finder?zip_code_filter=27949&x=12&y=16&page_number=0 and enter your ZIP code (use the finder itself, not the example ZIP) to see smart-thermostat rebates from your utility.

Open your utility's rebate page from the finder results and confirm three things: the qualifying-model list, the purchase window (e.g., PSE: purchase/install/connect by 12/31/2026), and the filing deadline (e.g., 60 days from purchase for PSE, 120 days from installation for Naperville).
Purchase a qualifying Wi-Fi smart thermostat (check it is ENERGY STAR certified / on the qualified list) inside the window and keep the dated, paid receipt showing the model number.
Install the thermostat and register/connect it via Wi-Fi with the manufacturer, if the program requires connection (PSE does).
Submit the rebate application through the utility's portal or form with your account number, the receipt, and model number — inside the filing deadline.
Receive the rebate as a bill credit, check, or prepaid gift card; if it arrives as a gift card (e.g., SWEPCO), activate it within the stated window.
timing: File within 60 days of purchase (PSE) or 120 days of installation (Naperville); credit/check issued roughly 4-8 weeks after a verified application. Norwich PUC FY27: requests must be received by July 15, 2027.
